index_returns.description: Calculates the percentage return of indexes over the past 3 months.
index_returns.template:
WITH three_months_data AS (
    SELECT index_symbol, close as close_price, trade_date
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT index_symbol, 
       (SELECT close_price FROM three_months_data ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / 
       (SELECT close_price FROM three_months_data ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) - 1 AS return_pct
FROM three_months_data
GROUP BY index_symbol
LIMIT 100;
